mapper.select: SELECT CARD_ID AS cardId, USER_ID AS userId, LINKED_ACCOUNT_ID AS linkedAccountId, LINKED_BANK_CODE AS linkedBankCode, EXTERNAL_CARD_ID AS externalCardId, CARD_INSTITUTION_NAME AS cardInstitutionName, CARD_NAME AS cardName, CARD_TYPE AS cardType, CARD_NUMBER_MASKED AS cardNumberMasked, CARD_BALANCE AS cardBalance, CARD_IS_ACTIVE AS cardIsActive, CARD_SYNCED_AT AS cardSyncedAt FROM `CARD` WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND CARD_IS_ACTIVE = TRUE ORDER BY CARD_ID

SELECT CARD_ID AS cardId, USER_ID AS userId, LINKED_ACCOUNT_ID AS linkedAccountId, LINKED_BANK_CODE AS linkedBankCode, EXTERNAL_CARD_ID AS externalCardId, CARD_INSTITUTION_NAME AS cardInstitutionName, CARD_NAME AS cardName, CARD_TYPE AS cardType, CARD_NUMBER_MASKED AS cardNumberMasked, CARD_BALANCE AS cardBalance, CARD_IS_ACTIVE AS cardIsActive, CARD_SYNCED_AT AS cardSyncedAt FROM `CARD` WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND EXTERNAL_CARD_ID = #{externalCardId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `CARD` ( USER_ID, LINKED_ACCOUNT_ID, LINKED_BANK_CODE, EXTERNAL_CARD_ID, CARD_INSTITUTION_NAME, CARD_NAME, CARD_TYPE, CARD_NUMBER_MASKED, CARD_BALANCE, CARD_IS_ACTIVE, CARD_SYNCED_AT ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{linkedAccountId}, #{linkedBankCode}, #{externalCardId}, #{cardInstitutionName}, #{cardName}, #{cardType}, #{cardNumberMasked}, #{cardBalance}, #{cardIsActive}, #{cardSyncedAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE `CARD` SET LINKED_ACCOUNT_ID = #{linkedAccountId}, LINKED_BANK_CODE = #{linkedBankCode}, CARD_INSTITUTION_NAME = #{cardInstitutionName}, CARD_NAME = #{cardName}, CARD_TYPE = #{cardType}, CARD_NUMBER_MASKED = #{cardNumberMasked}, CARD_BALANCE = #{cardBalance}, CARD_IS_ACTIVE = #{cardIsActive}, CARD_SYNCED_AT = #{cardSyncedAt} WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND EXTERNAL_CARD_ID = #{externalCardId}
